title: vlm-illusion-ladder: an instruction ladder for classical visual illusions in vision-language models
description: 300 self-drawn stimuli of 25 classical visual illusions (normal, reversed and control conditions), an 8-rung instruction ladder of prompts from a false fact to the stated truth, 460,800 responses of Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 with thinking off and on, and the analysis code. Code: MIT. Stimuli, prompts, data and results: CC BY 4.0.
